description: Rename, change status/visibility (Pro/Student only for private), default signal flow, title block fields, the sizing standard and its ampacity column, the length unit, the voltage-drop limits, or the spare-terminal percentage. title_block keys are the PDF template's field ids (built-in: drawingNo, drawnBy, customer, rev; custom template fields have their own ids).

ambient_c.description: Ambient temperature the ampacity is corrected for, in °C (0–100). null = the default 40 °C (inside the enclosure).

bom_report.description: PDF: a bill of materials, the last section (default on when the project has anything to list).

bundle_min.description: Fewest wires between two subsystems that draw as one bundle on screen (one trunk line; it never prints). Default 3; null resets it.

connector_tags.description: Tags for new in-line connectors (category connector): x = X10, X11… (default), jp = J1… for female, P1… for male. Existing ones keep their tags.

default_block.description: Terminal block part (id or part number) new strips and strip terminals use when none is picked. null = generic block.

default_pe_block.description: Same, for protective-earth strips. null = generic PE block.

drop_branch_pct.description: Branch voltage-drop limit — from the last fuse or breaker to the load — in % of the signal's volts (0–100). null = the default 3 %.

drop_total_pct.description: Total voltage-drop limit to the supply, in % of the signal's volts (0–100). null = the default 5 %.

gauge_on_labels.description: Printed wire labels include the gauge ("24VDC (+) 18 AWG BU"). Default false.

gauge_units.description: Wire gauge units in the grid, labels and PDF (default awg). In mm2 projects a bare gauge number means mm².

harness_min.description: Deprecated: the old name of bundle_min.

harness_report.description: PDF: a drawing sheet and a breakout table per harness you made (default true). Bundles never print.

length_unit.description: Unit lengths are entered and shown in (default ft). Stored lengths are metres either way.

pack_on_fix.description: fix_fanouts / Fix all re-pack the strips they touch.

pid_sheets.description: PDF: P&ID sheets after the schematic (default on when the project has P&ID items).

pinout_report.description: PDF: a pinout table per mated pair, feed-through and wired unmated connector (default true).

project_type.description: What the project is; sets defaults. vehicle (vehicle / harness): fix_fanouts uses splices; enclosure (cabinet) and electronics: terminal strips. null clears it.

sizing_column.description: Ampacity / insulation column of the standard (e.g. "75C", "105C-outside"); must be one of its columns. null = the standard's default.

sizing_report.description: PDF: a sizing report page, one section per fuse or breaker (default on when any wire has sizing data).

sizing_standard.description: Sizing standard behind gauge and fuse suggestions (default nec). electronics: dev boards, breakouts and header pins, ampacity down to 30 AWG and no minimum size on DC or signal wires.

spare_terminal_pct.description: Packing (Clean up, fix_fanouts) appends this many spare terminals per strip, in % of its used terminals (0–50), empty and unlocked at the end. null = none.

strip_naming.description: Tags for new strips: tb = TB1 / TB-PWR1 (default), iec = -X1, -X2. Existing strips keep their tags.

strip_report.description: PDF: a terminal strip report page per strip (default true).
